items.headline: Futures Mixed as Investors Eye Earnings and CPI Data; S&P 500 Extends Record Run
items.summary: U.S. stock futures showed mixed movements this Monday morning, with Nasdaq and S&P 500 futures up marginally, while Dow futures dipped. This comes as markets anticipate a busy week of corporate earnings and crucial CPI inflation data. The S&P 500 has continued its upward trajectory, trading near 7,771 in early trading, building on last Friday's record close of 7,757.64.

items.headline: SpaceX Surges on Lockup Expiry
items.summary: Elon Musk's SpaceX surged 15.8% recently, a day after the expiry of the first of several share lockup restrictions following its record public offering in June.

items.headline: Atlassian Posts Record Daily Gain
items.summary: Collaboration software maker Atlassian ($TEAM) saw a significant jump of 35.3%, marking its largest-ever daily percentage gain in recent trading.

items.headline: Microchip Tech Jumps on Strong Forecast
items.summary: Chip company Microchip Tech ($MCHP) climbed 13.9%, achieving its best daily performance in over 15 months after forecasting quarterly revenue above analyst estimates.

items.headline: Airbnb Leads S&P 500 Gainers
items.summary: Vacation rental company Airbnb ($ABNB) rose 17.4%, making it the best performer on the S&P 500 after exceeding second-quarter revenue estimates.

items.headline: Nebius Group Dips Amid Earnings Season
items.summary: Nebius Group ($NBIS) saw a decline of 1.01% as the market enters a busy week of corporate earnings reports.

items.headline: Weak Jobs Report Eases Fed Rate Hike Fears
items.summary: The U.S. economy unexpectedly shed 23,000 jobs in July, significantly below expectations, pushing the unemployment rate down to 4.1%. This weak report has led most traders to anticipate the Federal Reserve will maintain interest rates unchanged at 3.50% to 3.75% in September.

items.headline: Inflation Data Looms with CPI and PPI Ahead
items.summary: Investors are closely watching for key inflation data this week, with the Consumer Price Index (CPI) due on August 12 and the Producer Price Index (PPI) on August 13, which will be critical for assessing price stability and future monetary policy.

items.headline: Technology and Industrials Showing Improving Momentum
items.summary: In sector analysis, Technology and Industrials are demonstrating strengthening relative momentum, positioned as potential leaders. Materials, Consumer Staples, Real Estate, and Energy continue to lead, while Utilities has shifted into a lagging position.

items.headline: Busy Week for Corporate Earnings Reports
items.summary: A wave of major companies are scheduled to release earnings this week, including Super Micro Computer ($SMCI), CoreWeave ($CRWV), Cisco Systems ($CSCO), Hims & Hers ($HIMS), Applied Materials ($AMAT), Plug Power ($PLUG), Rocket Lab USA ($RKLB), Archer Aviation ($ACHR), and AST SpaceMobile ($ASTS). Rakuten Group ($RKUNY) also released its Q2 FY2026 financial results today.

items.headline: Oil Prices Rise Amid Strait of Hormuz Uncertainty
items.summary: Oil prices climbed in pre-market trading this morning, driven by ongoing uncertainty surrounding the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and mixed signals regarding potential agreements between the U.S. and Iran. Brent crude rose 2.14% to $85.40 a barrel, and WTI crude increased 2.05% to $78.88 a barrel.
